vocab.sentence: The chickens were eating when I saw them.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我看到那些雞時，牠們正在吃東西。

vocab.sentence: An ant was walking on the rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時一隻螞蟻正在岩石上爬行。

vocab.sentence: The ugly duck was swimming in the pool then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時那隻醜小鴨正在水池裡游泳。

vocab.sentence: The ducks were swimming when we got there.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們到那裡時，那些鴨子正在游泳。

vocab.sentence: The goose was eating when the boy came.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 男孩來的時候，那隻鵝正在吃東西。

vocab.sentence: A frog was sitting on the rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時一隻青蛙正坐在岩石上。

vocab.sentence: The cow was drinking water at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時那隻母牛正在喝水。

vocab.sentence: We checked the map before we left home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離家前先查看了地圖。

vocab.sentence: We were laughing at the beginning of the story.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 故事一開始時，我們正在笑。

vocab.sentence: He was standing in the middle of the room.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他當時正站在房間中央。

vocab.sentence: We left home at a quarter past seven.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在七點十五分離開家。

vocab.sentence: We were walking along the river at five yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 昨天五點時，我們正沿著河邊走。

vocab.sentence: The sky was clear when we left home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離家時，天空很晴朗。

vocab.sentence: We saw a cow when we passed the farm.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們經過農場時看到一隻母牛。

vocab.sentence: They were walking in the forest at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時他們正在森林裡走路。

vocab.sentence: The clothes were dry when I got home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我到家時，衣服已經乾了。

vocab.sentence: Something was moving in the jar at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時有個東西正在罐子裡動。

vocab.sentence: She washed the jar before she used it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她使用罐子前先把它洗乾淨。

vocab.sentence: The duck was cleaning its beak at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時那隻鴨子正在清理牠的嘴。

vocab.sentence: We reached the pool before it got dark.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在天黑前到達水池邊。

vocab.sentence: The bird was standing on a rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時那隻鳥正站在一塊岩石上。

vocab.sentence: A bird was flying over the forest then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時一隻鳥正飛過森林上空。

vocab.sentence: He came back after he finished his work.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他做完工作後回來了。

vocab.sentence: She dropped the jar when she saw the frog.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她看到青蛙時，手中的罐子掉了下來。

vocab.sentence: He looked into the jar before he moved it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他移動罐子前先往裡面看。

vocab.sentence: We finally reached the pool before it got dark.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們終於在天黑前到達水池邊。

vocab.sentence: We rested after we reached the top of the hill.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們到達山丘頂端後休息了一下。

vocab.sentence: They were eating lunch at half past twelve.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 十二點半時，他們正在吃午餐。

vocab.sentence: I finished my homework before I watched TV.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我看電視前先完成了作業。

vocab.sentence: Did you eat anything before you went swimming?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你去游泳前有吃任何東西嗎？

vocab.sentence: The boys were shouting when the teacher came in.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 老師進來時，那些男孩正在喊叫。

vocab.sentence: She shouted with joy when she saw her dog.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她看到自己的狗時高興得叫了出來。

vocab.sentence: We were swimming in the pool at four yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 昨天四點時，我們正在游泳池裡游泳。

vocab.sentence: I was reading when my brother came home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我弟弟回家時，我正在看書。

vocab.sentence: The duck came close when I sat down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我坐下時，那隻鴨子靠近了。

phrases.sentence: She picked up the map before she left.
Mom said, “Good job!” after I cleaned the room.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我打掃完房間後，媽媽說：「做得好！」

phrases.sentence: Dad was proud of me when I won.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我獲勝時，爸爸以我為榮。

phrases.sentence: The boy was walking back and forth then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 當時那個男孩正在來回走動。

tips.label: 當……時
tips.text: when 連接兩件事；放句首時，子句後加逗號。

tips.label: 先後順序
tips.text: A before B：A 先、B 後；A after B：B 先、A 後。

tips.label: 過去正在做
tips.text: I／he／she／it 用 was＋V-ing；you／we／they 用 were＋V-ing。

tips.label: 否定與問句
tips.text: 否定在 was／were 後加 not；問句把 was／were 移到主詞前。

tips.label: 過去事件的背景
tips.text: I was reading when Dad came home.：爸爸回家時，我正在閱讀。

tips.label: 未來時間子句
tips.text: when／before／after 引導的未來時間子句用現在式，主句可以用 will。

tips.label: 時間逆讀
tips.text: 先說分鐘再說鐘點：7:15 是 a quarter past seven；7:45 是 a quarter to eight。

notes.title: when 的位置與意思
notes.rule: When＋主詞＋動詞, 主詞＋動詞.
notes.description: when 表示「當……時」，連接兩件事。時間子句放句首時，後面加逗號；放主句後面通常不加逗號。先找每一個子句的主詞和動詞，不要只看到 when 就固定選某一種時態。
examples: When the duck came close, the boy smiled.（鴨子靠近時，男孩笑了。）
The boy smiled when the duck came close.（男孩在鴨子靠近時笑了。）

notes.title: when 與習慣、過去事件
notes.rule: 習慣：現在式；過去事件：依情境使用過去式或過去進行式。
notes.description: 習慣性的事情可用現在式，第三人稱單數要注意動詞變化。描述已發生的事件時依時間線索用過去式；描述當時正在進行的動作時用過去進行式。
examples: When the cow feels thirsty, it drinks water.（母牛口渴時會喝水。）
When I passed the forest yesterday, I saw a goose.（昨天經過森林時，我看到一隻鵝。）

notes.title: before／after 與先後順序
notes.description: before 表示「在……之前」，after 表示「在……之後」。不要把句子前後位置直接當成事件順序；要看連接詞。改寫時必須保留原來的先後關係。
examples: We checked the map before we entered the forest.（我們先看地圖，再進森林。）
We entered the forest after we checked the map.（我們看完地圖後進森林。）

notes.title: 時間連接詞後面接完整子句
notes.description: before 和 after 可作連接詞，後接有主詞和動詞的子句；也可作介系詞，後接名詞。名詞前不必另外補一個主詞與動詞。
examples: Wash your hands before you eat dinner.（吃晚餐前洗手。）
Wash your hands before dinner.（晚餐前洗手。）

notes.title: 未來的時間子句
notes.rule: When／Before／After＋現在式, 主詞＋will＋原形動詞.
notes.description: 談未來時，when／before／after 引導的時間子句通常用現在式，不用 will。第三人稱單數仍要加 -s 或 -es。主句也可以是祈使句。這條規則適用於時間子句；詢問未來時間的 When will you come back? 是直接問句，仍可用 will。
examples: When Dad comes back tomorrow, we will show him the map.（爸爸明天回來時，我們會給他看地圖。）
Call me after you reach the pool tomorrow.（明天到游泳池後打電話給我。）

notes.title: 過去進行式的肯定句
notes.description: 表示過去某個時間正在發生的動作。I、he、she、it 或單數名詞用 was；you、we、they 或複數名詞用 were。常見線索有 at eight last night、then、at that time。yesterday 也能和過去進行式搭配，不能只因為沒有鐘點就判為錯誤。
examples: The goose was swimming at five yesterday.（昨天五點時，那隻鵝正在游泳。）
The ants were moving along the wall then.（當時那些螞蟻正沿著牆壁爬。）

notes.title: V-ing 的變化
notes.rule: 一般加 -ing；不發音的 e 去掉再加 -ing；部分字尾要雙寫。
notes.description: read → reading、fly → flying；make → making、write → writing；run → running、swim → swimming、drop → dropping。過去進行式要用 V-ing，不能用過去式或原形代替。
examples: The bird was flying over the pool.（那隻鳥當時正飛過水池上空。）
The boy was dropping rocks into the jar.（男孩當時正把石頭丟進罐子裡。）

notes.title: 否定句與 Yes／No 問句
notes.description: 否定時在 was／were 後加 not，不加 didn’t。問句把 was／were 移到主詞前，後面的動詞仍用 V-ing。簡答沿用 was／were，並注意人稱轉換：Were you…? → Yes, I was.
examples: She wasn’t shouting; she was singing.（她當時不是在喊叫，而是在唱歌。）
Were you looking for the map? Yes, I was.（你當時在找地圖嗎？是的。）
Were the ducks sleeping? No, they weren’t.（鴨子當時在睡覺嗎？不，牠們沒有。）

notes.title: Wh- 問句
notes.description: What 問做什麼，Where 問地點，When 問時間。Who 作主詞時，不再另外放一個主詞；本課以單數的 Who was…? 為例。回答要符合問句所問的內容與時間。
examples: What were you doing at nine last night?（昨晚九點你正在做什麼？）
Where was the frog hiding? Under a rock.（青蛙當時躲在哪裡？石頭下面。）
Who was shouting then? My brother.（那時誰在喊叫？我弟弟。）

notes.title: when 搭配過去進行式
notes.description: 用過去進行式描述事件發生時正在進行的背景動作，另一個過去事件常用簡單過去式。when 本身不強制兩邊各用哪一種時態；要看句子是在說持續中的背景，還是先後完成的事件。
examples: I was checking the map when the bus arrived.（公車到站時，我正在看地圖。）
When the jar fell, the girl was washing her hands.（罐子掉下來時，女孩正在洗手。）

notes.title: 時間逆讀法
notes.rule: 1–30 分：分鐘＋past／after＋鐘點；31–59 分：差幾分鐘＋to＋下一個鐘點。
notes.description: 15 分鐘可說 a quarter，30 分鐘可說 half。7:15＝a quarter past seven；7:30＝half past seven；7:45＝a quarter to eight。to 後面要用下一個鐘點。逆讀法後不加 o’clock；o’clock 用於整點。詢問現在幾點用 What time is it?；詢問活動時間通常用 at＋時間。
examples: It is ten past six.（現在是六點十分。）
The game starts at twenty to nine.（比賽在八點四十分開始。）
It is eight o’clock.（現在是八點整。）

notes.title: 本課單字變化提醒
notes.description: goose 的複數是 geese；fly 的過去式是 flew，V-ing 是 flying。這些變化保留在同一個單字的說明中，不另外列為新單字。close 在本課是副詞「接近地」，不要和動詞「關閉」的用法混淆。
examples: One goose was swimming, and two geese were eating.（一隻鵝正在游泳，兩隻鵝正在吃東西。）
The bird flew away after it drank some water.（那隻鳥喝水後飛走了。）

quiz.question: The frog ___ hiding under a rock at six yesterday evening.
quiz.hint: at six yesterday evening 是過去時間，主詞 The frog 是單數，用 was＋hiding。

quiz.question: The ducks ___ swimming in the pool at that time yesterday.
quiz.hint: at that time yesterday 指昨天那時；複數主詞 The ducks 用 were＋swimming。

quiz.question: At seven last night, I was ___ the map for our trip.
quiz.hint: was 後面接 V-ing 構成過去進行式，因此用 checking。

quiz.question: A bird was ___ over the forest when we saw it.
quiz.hint: was 後要接 V-ing；fly 的 V-ing 是 flying，flew 是簡單過去式。

quiz.question: The boy was ___ rocks into a jar when I walked past.
quiz.hint: was＋V-ing 表當時正在進行的動作；drop 要雙寫 p 再加 -ing，成為 dropping。

quiz.question: At nine last night, Mom ___ making chicken soup in the kitchen.
quiz.hint: at nine last night 是過去時間，單數主詞 Mom 用 was making。

quiz.question: We ___ walking along the river at four yesterday afternoon.
quiz.hint: at four yesterday afternoon 指過去某時，We 用 were＋walking。

quiz.question: The cows were ___ water when the farmer came back.
quiz.hint: were 後接 V-ing；drink 的 V-ing 是 drinking，不是過去式 drank。

quiz.question: I ___ looking for my map at ten last night.
quiz.hint: I 在過去進行式中搭配 was；at ten last night 排除現在式。

quiz.question: Something ___ moving inside the jar when I picked it up.
quiz.hint: Something 當單數主詞，picked it up 表過去事件，因此用 was moving。

quiz.question: The children ___ sleeping at eight last night. They were still playing.
quiz.hint: They were still playing 說明當時沒有在睡覺；複數主詞搭配 weren’t sleeping。

quiz.question: I ___ watching TV when you called. I was doing my homework.
quiz.hint: I was doing my homework 表示當時沒有看電視；I 的過去進行式否定用 wasn’t watching。

quiz.question: ___ the goose eating when you took this photo yesterday?
quiz.hint: 問過去正在做的事，把 was 放在單數主詞 the goose 前，後面保留 eating。

quiz.question: ___ you and Ben looking for the pool at five yesterday?
quiz.hint: you and Ben 是複數主詞，問過去進行中的動作用 Were＋主詞＋looking。

quiz.question: A: Was the ant carrying food when you saw it? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: Was the ant carrying…? 的肯定簡答用 Yes, it was.，沿用 was。

quiz.question: A: Were the ducks sleeping then? B: No, they ___. They were swimming.
quiz.hint: Were…? 的否定簡答是 No, they weren’t.；後句 swimming 也說明沒有在睡。

quiz.question: A: ___ were you doing at the pool at four yesterday? B: I was swimming.
quiz.hint: 回答 I was swimming 說明當時做的事，因此問 What were you doing…?。

quiz.question: A: ___ was the frog hiding when you found it? B: Under a rock.
quiz.hint: Under a rock 是地點，應用 Where 詢問躲藏的位置。

quiz.question: A: Who ___ shouting outside at midnight last night? B: My brother.
quiz.hint: Who 作主詞，回答是單數 My brother；過去進行式用 Who was shouting…?。

quiz.question: A: Were you walking back and forth when I arrived? B: Yes, I ___.
quiz.hint: 問句的 you 在回答時改成 I；I 搭配 was，所以答 Yes, I was.。

quiz.question: Mia washed the jar at two and filled it at three. She washed it ___ she filled it.
quiz.hint: 兩點洗、三點裝入東西，洗在先，故用 before；after 會顛倒順序，until／because 不表示這個先後關係。

quiz.question: The rain stopped at four. We left home at five. We left ___ the rain stopped.
quiz.hint: 五點出門晚於四點雨停，用 after；because of 後不能直接接 the rain stopped 這個完整子句。

quiz.question: First, Leo picked up the map. Next, he put it in his bag. He put it away ___ he picked it up.
quiz.hint: 先撿起、再收好，收好發生在撿起之後，用 after；during 不能直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: We reached the top at ten and ate lunch at twelve. We reached the top ___ we ate lunch.
quiz.hint: 十點到頂端、十二點吃午餐，到頂端在先，用 before。其他選項無法表達題幹指定的先後關係。

quiz.question: Jen fed the chickens first and then cleaned their house. ___ Jen fed the chickens, she cleaned their house.
quiz.hint: 先餵雞再打掃，主句的打掃發生在餵雞之後，所以句首用 After 引導餵雞這件事。

quiz.question: The children put on their shoes first and then went outside. ___ they went outside, they put on their shoes.
quiz.hint: 先穿鞋再出門，穿鞋在出門之前，用 Before they went outside。

quiz.question: Nina finished her homework at six yesterday. After that, she ___ to the pool.
quiz.hint: at six yesterday 指過去；接著走去游泳池也是過去事件，用 walked。walking 單獨不能作完整謂語。

quiz.question: Before Tom ___ the jar yesterday, he washed it carefully.
quiz.hint: yesterday 與 washed 表過去事件；使用罐子用過去式 used，using 不能單獨作此子句的謂語。

quiz.question: Every morning, the farmer checks the water before he ___ the cows.
quiz.hint: Every morning 與 checks 表習慣；before 子句主詞 he 是第三人稱單數，動詞用 feeds。

quiz.question: The children always wash their hands after they ___ the animals.
quiz.hint: always wash 表現在的習慣；they 搭配現在式 touch，不加 -s。

quiz.question: The goose is quiet before it sees the farmer with food. It starts making loud sounds ___ it sees him.
quiz.hint: 看見拿著食物的農夫之前很安靜，看見他時才開始叫，用 when 表當下的時間關係；until 表持續到某時，so／but 表結果或轉折，都不符合這個前後描述。

quiz.question: When Dad ___ back tomorrow, we will show him our new map.
quiz.hint: tomorrow 表未來，但 when 引導的時間子句用現在式；Dad 是第三人稱單數，用 comes。

quiz.question: I will call you after I ___ the forest tomorrow morning.
quiz.hint: after 引導未來時間子句，使用現在式 leave；will 放在主句，不放在這個時間子句。

quiz.question: Before the game ___ tomorrow, we will check the pool.
quiz.hint: before 引導未來時間子句，用現在式；單數主詞 the game 搭配 starts。

quiz.question: When my sister feels sad, she usually ___ along the river.
quiz.hint: usually 表習慣，單數主詞 she 的現在式動詞用 walks。

quiz.question: When the children ___ thirsty, they always ask for water.
quiz.hint: always ask 表現在習慣，複數主詞 the children 用 feel。

quiz.question: Please ___ me when you get to the pool tomorrow.
quiz.hint: Please 開頭的祈使句用原形動詞 call；when 子句說明打電話的時間。

quiz.question: A: ___ will you come back from the forest? B: At four tomorrow afternoon.
quiz.hint: 回答是時間，用 When；這是直接問句 When will you…?，不是 when 引導的時間子句。

quiz.question: When I ___ the farm yesterday, a cow was drinking water.
quiz.hint: yesterday 指過去；when 子句需要完整動詞，用 passed 表經過農場這件過去的事。

quiz.question: We were watching the frogs when Dad ___ us from the house last night.
quiz.hint: last night 與 were watching 都指過去；when 子句用 called 表爸爸叫我們的事件。

quiz.question: A: What was Amy doing when the jar fell? B: She ___ her hands.
quiz.hint: 問句 What was Amy doing…? 要回答當時進行中的動作；She was washing her hands 符合過去時間和進行式。

quiz.question: A: What were the birds doing when you looked up? B: They ___ over the forest.
quiz.hint: 問句問過去正在做的事，複數主詞 They 用 were flying；flying 單獨缺 be 動詞。

quiz.question: A: It is 7:15 now. How do we say that? B: It is ___ seven.
quiz.hint: 7:15 是七點過十五分鐘，即 a quarter past seven；to 表差幾分鐘到下一個鐘點。

quiz.question: The clock shows 8:45. It is ___.
quiz.hint: 8:45 距離九點還差十五分鐘，是 a quarter to nine；to 後用下一個鐘點。

quiz.question: The pool opens at 6:30 in the morning. It opens at ___.
quiz.hint: 6:30 是六點過三十分鐘，half past six；half 表半小時。

quiz.question: It is 9:20 now. It is ___ nine.
quiz.hint: 9:20 是九點過二十分鐘，用 twenty past nine；twenty to nine 則是 8:40。

quiz.question: We will leave at 10:50. That is ___.
quiz.hint: 10:50 距離十一點差十分鐘，用 ten to eleven，鐘點要往下一小時算。

quiz.question: A: It is 2:30 now. When does the bus leave? B: In fifteen minutes, at ___ three.
quiz.hint: 2:30 加十五分鐘是 2:45，即 a quarter to three。先計算實際時間，再用逆讀法。

quiz.question: A: Is it five to six? B: No, it is five ___ six. The clock shows 6:05.
quiz.hint: 6:05 是六點過五分鐘，five past six；five to six 是 5:55。此題考時間逆讀的方向。

quiz.question: The map lesson begins at 4:40. It begins at ___.
quiz.hint: 4:40 距離五點還差二十分鐘，用 twenty to five；to 後用下一個鐘點。

vocab.sentence: The chickens were eating when I saw them.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我看到那些雞時，牠們正在吃東西。

vocab.sentence: An ant was walking on the rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時一隻螞蟻正在岩石上爬行。

vocab.sentence: The ugly duck was swimming in the pool then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時那隻醜小鴨正在水池裡游泳。

vocab.sentence: The ducks were swimming when we got there.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們到那裡時，那些鴨子正在游泳。

vocab.sentence: The goose was eating when the boy came.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 男孩來的時候，那隻鵝正在吃東西。

vocab.sentence: A frog was sitting on the rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時一隻青蛙正坐在岩石上。

vocab.sentence: The cow was drinking water at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時那隻母牛正在喝水。

vocab.sentence: We checked the map before we left home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離家前先查看了地圖。

vocab.sentence: We were laughing at the beginning of the story.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 故事一開始時，我們正在笑。

vocab.sentence: He was standing in the middle of the room.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他當時正站在房間中央。

vocab.sentence: We left home at a quarter past seven.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在七點十五分離開家。

vocab.sentence: We were walking along the river at five yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 昨天五點時，我們正沿著河邊走。

vocab.sentence: The sky was clear when we left home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離家時，天空很晴朗。

vocab.sentence: We saw a cow when we passed the farm.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們經過農場時看到一隻母牛。

vocab.sentence: They were walking in the forest at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時他們正在森林裡走路。

vocab.sentence: The clothes were dry when I got home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我到家時，衣服已經乾了。

vocab.sentence: Something was moving in the jar at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時有個東西正在罐子裡動。

vocab.sentence: She washed the jar before she used it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她使用罐子前先把它洗乾淨。

vocab.sentence: The duck was cleaning its beak at that time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那時那隻鴨子正在清理牠的嘴。

vocab.sentence: We reached the pool before it got dark.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在天黑前到達水池邊。

vocab.sentence: The bird was standing on a rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時那隻鳥正站在一塊岩石上。

vocab.sentence: A bird was flying over the forest then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當時一隻鳥正飛過森林上空。

vocab.sentence: He came back after he finished his work.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他做完工作後回來了。

vocab.sentence: She dropped the jar when she saw the frog.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她看到青蛙時，手中的罐子掉了下來。

vocab.sentence: He looked into the jar before he moved it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他移動罐子前先往裡面看。

vocab.sentence: We finally reached the pool before it got dark.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們終於在天黑前到達水池邊。

vocab.sentence: We rested after we reached the top of the hill.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們到達山丘頂端後休息了一下。

vocab.sentence: They were eating lunch at half past twelve.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 十二點半時，他們正在吃午餐。

vocab.sentence: I finished my homework before I watched TV.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我看電視前先完成了作業。

vocab.sentence: Did you eat anything before you went swimming?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你去游泳前有吃任何東西嗎？

vocab.sentence: The boys were shouting when the teacher came in.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 老師進來時，那些男孩正在喊叫。

vocab.sentence: She shouted with joy when she saw her dog.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她看到自己的狗時高興得叫了出來。

vocab.sentence: We were swimming in the pool at four yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 昨天四點時，我們正在游泳池裡游泳。

vocab.sentence: I was reading when my brother came home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我弟弟回家時，我正在看書。

vocab.sentence: The duck came close when I sat down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我坐下時，那隻鴨子靠近了。

phrases.sentence: She picked up the map before she left.
Mom said, “Good job!” after I cleaned the room.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我打掃完房間後，媽媽說：「做得好！」

phrases.sentence: Dad was proud of me when I won.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我獲勝時，爸爸以我為榮。

phrases.sentence: The boy was walking back and forth then.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 當時那個男孩正在來回走動。

grammar.sentence: The ugly duck was swimming near the bridge.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻醜小鴨當時正在橋附近游泳。

grammar.sentence: Were you checking the map at that time?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你那時正在查看地圖嗎？

grammar.sentence: We washed the jar before we used it.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們使用罐子前先把它洗乾淨。

grammar.sentence: The ant was carrying food along the wall.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻螞蟻當時正沿著牆壁搬食物。

grammar.sentence: It was a quarter to eight then.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 當時是七點四十五分。

grammar.sentence: What were the children doing near the pool?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些孩子當時正在水池附近做什麼？

grammar.sentence: After the rain stopped, we entered the forest.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 雨停了之後，我們進入森林。

grammar.sentence: The goose was not sleeping at that time.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻鵝那時沒有在睡覺。

grammar.sentence: When Dad arrives tomorrow, we will leave together.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸明天抵達時，我們會一起離開。

grammar.sentence: They were picking up rocks when I arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我抵達時，他們正在撿石頭。

grammar.sentence: She finished her work before she went swimming.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她去游泳前先完成了工作。

grammar.sentence: Who was shouting in the middle of the night?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 半夜時誰在喊叫？

grammar.sentence: The farmer was feeding the cows at noon.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 中午時，那位農夫正在餵母牛。

grammar.sentence: Our bus leaves at twenty to seven.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們的公車在六點四十分發車。

grammar.sentence: The bird flew away after it drank water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻鳥喝水後飛走了。

grammar.sentence: I was reading when something hit the window.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有個東西撞上窗戶時，我正在看書。

grammar.sentence: Were the frogs hiding under those rocks then?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些青蛙當時正躲在那些岩石下面嗎？

grammar.sentence: Wash your hands before you eat the chicken.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 吃雞肉前先洗手。

grammar.sentence: When the chickens feel hungry, they make loud sounds.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些雞餓的時候會發出很大的聲音。

grammar.sentence: The boy was not walking back and forth.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩當時沒有在來回走動。

grammar.sentence: The game began at a quarter past three.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 比賽在三點十五分開始。

grammar.sentence: After we reached the top, we took photos.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們到達頂端後拍了照片。

grammar.sentence: Where was your brother standing when you waved?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你揮手時，你哥哥正站在哪裡？

grammar.sentence: The girl was dropping stones into the jar.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個女孩當時正在把石頭丟進罐子裡。

grammar.sentence: Please call me when you get back tomorrow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你明天回來時，請打電話給我。

grammar.sentence: She shouted with joy when she saw the gift.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她看到禮物時高興得叫了出來。

grammar.sentence: The pool closes at half past six.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 游泳池在六點半關閉。

grammar.sentence: We will eat after we finish the game.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們完成遊戲後會吃東西。

grammar.sentence: I was cleaning when Mom said good job.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 媽媽說做得好時，我正在打掃。

grammar.sentence: Was the bird cleaning its beak at that time?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻鳥那時正在清理牠的嘴嗎？

cloze_quiz.question: We cannot find the river. Let us use this ___ to see where it is.
cloze_quiz.hint: 要找河流的位置，需要查看地圖 map；其他選項是罐子、鳥嘴、母牛。

cloze_quiz.question: A tiny ___ with six legs is carrying food to its nest on the ground.
cloze_quiz.hint: tiny、six legs 和搬食物回巢指出是螞蟻 ant；其餘動物沒有六隻腳。

cloze_quiz.question: The white ___ has feathers, a long neck, and two feet. It is eating grass.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有羽毛、長脖子和兩隻腳的是鵝 goose；其他選項沒有羽毛。

cloze_quiz.question: The bird holds a small fish in its ___ before eating it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 鳥吃魚前用鳥嘴 beak 銜住魚；wing、foot、tail 分別是翅膀、腳和尾巴，這裡用 in its beak。

cloze_quiz.question: We keep the jam in a glass ___ with a lid.
cloze_quiz.hint: 裝果醬、有蓋子的玻璃容器是罐子 jar；地圖、岩石和水池不符合。

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ is full of tall trees, and many wild animals live there.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有很多高樹、野生動物居住的地方是森林 forest；其餘是室內房間。

cloze_quiz.question: There are four equal pieces of cake. Each piece is a ___ of the whole cake.
cloze_quiz.hint: 平均分成四份，每份是四分之一 quarter；half、third、tenth 是二分之一、三分之一、十分之一。

cloze_quiz.question: Please read from the ___ of the story, starting with the very first word.
cloze_quiz.hint: starting with the very first word 表示從故事開頭 beginning 讀起；不是中間、結尾或標題。

cloze_quiz.question: There are five chairs in a row. The third chair is in the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 五張椅子排成一列，第三張位於中間 middle；其餘選項都不是排列中的位置。

cloze_quiz.question: We climbed all the way up the hill and stopped at its highest point, the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: highest point 指最高處，也就是頂端 top；bottom、middle、side 是底部、中間和側邊。

cloze_quiz.question: There was great ___ in her voice when she heard that she had won first prize.
cloze_quiz.hint: 得知拿到第一名，聲音中流露喜悅 joy；其他選項是恐懼、憤怒和悲傷。

cloze_quiz.question: The shoes look so ___ to me. I think their shape and colors are terrible.
cloze_quiz.hint: 覺得形狀和顏色很糟，表示認為鞋子醜陋 ugly；另外三項都是正面描述，均不符合 terrible。

cloze_quiz.question: The towel was wet this morning, but there is no water in it now. It is ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 原本濕、現在沒有水分，表示已經乾燥 dry；wet 相反，hungry 和 thirsty 不適合形容毛巾。

cloze_quiz.question: There are no clouds in the sky today. The sky is ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: no clouds 表示天空晴朗 clear；其他選項分別指多雲、下雨和下雪。

cloze_quiz.question: The cookie is too high on the shelf. The little boy cannot ___ it with his hand.
cloze_quiz.hint: too high 與 with his hand 表示手伸不到餅乾，用 reach；hear、smell、drink 不符合伸手拿的意思。

cloze_quiz.question: Only one question is left. I can ___ my homework in two minutes.
cloze_quiz.hint: 只剩一題、再兩分鐘即可完成作業，用 finish；start、forget、lose 不符合快做完的情境。

cloze_quiz.question: The music is very loud, so you need to ___ for me to hear you.
cloze_quiz.hint: 音樂很大聲，需要大聲喊叫 shout 才能被聽見；whisper 是低聲說話，另外兩項與說話無關。

cloze_quiz.question: Hold the glass tightly. If you ___ it, it may fall to the floor and break.
cloze_quiz.hint: 玻璃杯會掉到地上摔破，對應失手讓它落下 drop；wash、fill、hold 沒有落下的意思。

cloze_quiz.question: The boy lay flat on his ___ with his face toward the sky.
cloze_quiz.hint: 臉朝天空平躺，表示背部 back 貼著地面；stomach、face、feet 都不符合這個姿勢。

cloze_quiz.question: We tried ten times without success. On our eleventh try, we ___ opened the box.
cloze_quiz.hint: 失敗十次後第十一次終於成功，用 finally；never、rarely、seldom 表示從未或很少，與這次成功的敘述不符。
